spans.text: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt before storage — plaintext is never persisted.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates strong privacy and data protection practices. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt, plaintext is never persisted, inputs are sanitized, and the documentation advises using a strong secret key. Session-scoped tokens limit data exposure.

spans.text: Rate limits protect the register (10/hour) and login (20/min) endpoints against brute force.
spans.note: The prompt implements several tool and action safety measures including rate limiting on sensitive endpoints, scoped tokens with least privilege (session tokens scoped to a single session_id), input sanitization, and JWT uniqueness via jti claims. These measures protect system integrity.
